summary: Dumps one repo's file graph to out/<name>.json for the standalone sphere viewer. It READS the keeper's on-disk cache (loadCachedIndex with the 'gs' load profile) and never builds an index, so the target repo must already be indexed. Two things in here are non-obvious: directory bands are chosen ADAPTIVELY (assignClusters splits any band over 13% one segment deeper, then folds slivers), because a fixed depth-2 cut put 1093 of arches's 1615 files into one band; and because every file-level edge in index.edges is a plain import, the named verbs ('calls save(), load()') come from aggregating index.symbolEdges per file pair, not from index.edges.
